kb.a: An all-in-one operating system for credit repair agencies: CRM, AI-drafted dispute letters, 3-bureau tracking, a white-label client portal, messaging, billing and monthly progress updates. It includes a Marketing OS account.
Agency OS is $199/mo with unlimited active clients and no per-client fees; cancel anytime. DIY OS for individuals is $49.99/mo.

A white-label HighLevel sub-account (app.scoresos.com) included with your subscription, for funnels, conversations, calendars and automations. Phone, texting and AI usage are billed to you, and texting needs your own A2P registration.
Yes, yours. The client portal is white-labeled with your logo, colors and agency name.
I'm Score OS's AI. I help draft a unique dispute letter for each item and answer questions on the site and in the app. You review every letter before it's sent.
No. No one can legally guarantee credit repair results. Score OS gives you the tools to dispute inaccurate, unverifiable or outdated items and track every round.
Funding OS is coming soon. It's planned to check funding readiness and show goals a client may qualify for. It won't promise approvals.

kb.q: Can I add staff or an outsourcer?
kb.a: Yes. You can add staff and link an outsourcer to your agency with in-app messaging.
